# Andreas W. Neitzel

> PhD candidate in astronomy at IA/CAUP (Instituto de Astrofísica e Ciências do Espaço), University of Porto. Develops machine-learning methods for Galactic archaeology, focused on disentangling Milky Way stellar populations using *Gaia* BP/RP spectra and asteroseismic age priors. First author on Neitzel et al. 2025 (A&A 695, A243), which introduces a manifold-learning pipeline (UMAP + HDBSCAN) for chemodynamic separation of stellar populations on a synthetic Milky Way-like galaxy. Co-Investigator and lead developer of the ML pipelines for the FCT Exploratory Project ArqueoGal (2024.15303.PEX), which is extending the Neitzel 2025 method to real *Gaia* DR3 observations. Publications span manifold-learning methods, cool-dwarf asteroseismology with ESPRESSO, and stellar characterisation for the ESA *Ariel* mission.

## Research

- [Publications](https://andreaswneitzel.github.io/publications/): full list with DOI and ADS links
- [Neitzel et al. 2025, A&A 695, A243](https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202451718) ([arXiv:2501.16294](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.16294)): first-author paper introducing manifold learning (UMAP + HDBSCAN) for chemodynamic stellar-population separation on a synthetic Milky Way-like galaxy
- [Campante et al. 2024, A&A 683, L16](https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202449197): co-author; expanding cool-dwarf asteroseismology with ESPRESSO
- [Magrini et al. 2022, A&A 663, A161](https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243405): co-author; *Ariel* stellar characterisation of 187 FGK planet hosts

## Software

- [ArqueoGal](https://github.com/AndreasWNeitzel/ArqueoGal): FCT Exploratory Project 2024.15303.PEX. Extends the Neitzel 2025 method to real *Gaia* DR3 observations; open-source release scheduled December 2026
- [Stellar Explorer](https://andreaswneitzel.github.io/stellar-explorer/): browser-based interactive exploration of the stellar populations analysed in Neitzel 2025
